process/Git/cleanup execution. Main alone reviews and executes after current integrated run closes.
Neither this source contract nor SOURCEONLY report is an actual runtime or CPU qualification receipt.

cache_support.py: exact cachepacket7hash+health_capsSHA before policy/common import, exactownerSHA
before import, exclusive owned-v0141-measurement.lock across each helper step, NEW separate Broot,
normal anchored owned closure/exit0, sameboot, no retry/adoption/reset/unbind/service actions/cleanup.
Whole finite wall120CPU/420compile/240query/360resolver; commands finite min(remaining,requestwall).
CPU cap min(requested,parent hardCPU-1), never raises parent hard limit (Owner adds1 hard margin).
CPU scripts<=60, compile<=360, resolver<=180 per command; parent may lower them, then failure is retained.
Nested existing mock CPU30/hard31 requires sufficient inherited limit; insufficiency fails, never loosens.
RSS<=4GiB general/8GiB compiler, logs64MiB/root96MiB/files64MiB, explicitENV only, no numeric killpg.
Inherited qualified owner's emergency failure closure never counts as normal PASS; no new kill flow.
No artifacts retired/deleted. Main reviews compact excerpts/raw SHA and performs serialized retention.
Credentials forbidden receipt rejected by sha/load BEFORE any read, including symlink-resolved aliases.

cpu_step.py: actual cachepacket controller_cpu_fixtures.py in bounded child with owned normal mock
and actual invalidpending process/owner-import trap. Check inner normal anchored receipts and all4
CPU keys, exact7unchanged source pins. Separate caps_fixtures.py tests pure strict parser (no runtime),
missing/duplicate/unknown/split/malformed/oversize uint64/root/expectedID/limit/workload/relaxed fields
and Python bool pretending integer device IDs/limits. Source fixture ID constants are explicit Main
accepted0xe20c or synthetic only; no actual query conducted by implementer. Need Main full CPU receipt.

property_step.py --mode compile: rehash exact original installed compiler pins from closed original
latest-update-pristine-official-icpx-build-root-v2 receipt, source q unchanged pristine7695859/ELF49025...
source/library identities. --version then icpx -std=c++20 -fsycl -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror original
byte-identical cachepacket health_caps.cpp -lze_loader -o NEWroot/health_caps. No target binary/probe
run in compile mode. Record originalbuild/source/compilerprovider/new binary; no model/GPU workload.
Actual compile proof exists only when Main runs and normal owned commands close. No C++ copy/change.

--mode query: NEW closed compile-receipt SHA/binary/source, q provider/model-phase policy ENV exactly
policy.environment('official',False,extra[]), own V2 adapter and installed MKL/UMF/opt compiler dirs.
Original unchanged6-record native integer helper BEFORE and AFTER one property query; verify actual
protocol and same pinned actual library paths/SHA/stat, selected runtime errors fatal. These integer
probes DO allocate/copy/launch GPU workload: gpu_executed=true, integer_health_workload_attempts=2.
CAPS property counters separately zero allocations/kernels/contexts/queues/copies, never claim entire
bracket zeroGPU. property_query_attempts=1. Fresh xpu device-list one index0, selectedBDF05:00.0 normal,
actual pci_device_id0xe20c/vendor0x8086, finite tile0used<=256 before/after. Full boot kernel fault gate,
fresh cursor interval checks prehealth/property/posthealth/final and devcoredump absence. No secondjob.
One exact bounded<=2049bytes newline CAPS line, exact known unique keys, canonical uint64/bools,
strict vendor/native/root/query status and unset relaxedlimits; both max allocation>=1276953600.
No relaxedlimit flag changes. Actual caps fields match future common.cache_capacity proof schema,
sameboot/provider/source/binary/commands/explicitenv. Property pass necessary only, not allocation-fit/
residency/free-room/workspace/model inference proof; current model not launched by these helpers.
SIDE SOURCE COMPILE/QUERY assumes Main supplies original actual long q and no unresolved values.

resolve_step.py: Main supplies manifest+SHA with NEW CPU/full-read review/capacity receipt pins and
actual original official-long q pin. Revalidate original7source/source/binary q and full original actual
admission in finite CPU child using original long common.admit (no owner import/model launch).
Then bind cachepacket7new code, NEW actual CPU/review, actual CAPS/property receipt whose exact fields
and independent native0xe20c match parsed actual stdout, revalidate current common.admit including all
source/build/runtime/model identity/tools/library constraints and capacity gate. Preserve originalproof
paths/statuses, do not rewritefailed roots, no original admission implies new cache512 inferencePASS.
NEWroot/qualification.json and record explicit current_cache512_model_inference_tested=false; model
startup/model execution is a separate Main gate. Main source_review passed=true means actual full-read
source admission only; do not use SourceOnly implementation report as review/runtimePASS input.

Every helper requires explicit --main-reviewed flag; input manifest also main_reviewed=true. That
acknowledges Main actual review, not evidence execution happened during packet creation. Sourcepins
freeze exact original packet and reference helpers; Main binds helper manifest SHA before execution.
Readiness/library validation/tracing overhead retained, no speed/fit/quality/full256K claim.
R228/R232 exact512singleblock source threshold retained; R233-235 heldout/integration reports do not
qualify this separate pristine capacity experiment. Existing reportregistryv156 is reference only.

Main next: full read all5Python (<10KiB each), verify frozen sourcepins/manifest; bounded CPU fixtures;
actual compile then one property bracket only after activeGPUmodel closes normally and lock held;
NEW source review JSON and exact manifest; resolver; then separate cache512startup/current health/model
controller admission. No auto/1024 or new model framework. Unresolved pending manifests remain unusable.
